items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: And who was in your band? ... Fetter Burberry. ... And myself.

ctx.x: And who was in his band then?

And who was in your band? Blunt. Key Boy. Fetter Burberry. Murray's. Duran. Flying Fetter. And myself. Uh… Duran. Uh… There were seven pieces then. Ask him how long Duran played with his band. How long did Duran play with your band? Oh, yeah. Uh… Duran played with your band. Uh… Duran played with your band. Uh… Uh… Uh… Uh…
